documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of The Bard Meeting To Be Held On November 3, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Deep Industries Limited presented its corporate presentation outlining its operations as an integrated onshore and offshore oil and gas service provider. The company highlighted strong financial performance in FY26 and Q1 FY27, including significant increases in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management detailed its business verticals spanning natural gas compression, dehydration, processing facilities, drilling and workover rigs, integrated project management services, production enhancement, and offshore services via Dolphin Offshore. Furthermore, the company noted supportive government policies, sector tailwinds from initiatives like Samudra Manthan and GOBARdhan, and an expanding order book. Deep Industries reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance with consolidated revenue growing 40% year-on-year to INR278.92 crores and net profit rising 44.5% to INR89.14 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects consolidated revenue growth of more than 25% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So, on a stand-alone basis, we are not -- we are expecting growth of somewhere around 18% to 20% in this current financial year with a consolidated growth of more than 25%.

guidance.claim: Management guns for a PAT of almost INR500 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: No, on FY28, we are gunning for a PAT of almost INR 500 crores.

guidance.claim: For FY28, the production enhancement contract is expected to generate revenue of almost INR150-plus crores.
guidance.quote: And for FY28, we are quite bullish on getting almost more than INR150 crores of revenue from this particular contract.

demand_outlook.claim: Achieved all-time high quarterly revenue and profitability, driven by strong operational execution and market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Achieved all-time high quarterly revenue and profitability, driven by strong operational execution and market demand.

capex_expansion.quote: Asset size: the Company owns more than 80 gas compressors

capex_expansion.quote: So, it would not be more than INR10 crores, INR15 crores as our initial estimate suggests.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 44.24% for FY26.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR131.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 43.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Operational efficiencies have helped us post 38.7% Y-o-Y growth in EBITDA to INR131.8 crores in FY21 -- in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA margin of 43.6%.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%.
margins_costs.quote: We have been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%, providing us a decent cash flow to strategize our future growth trajectory.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing hydrocarbon fluids in-house at Kandla is estimated to improve operating margins by 1.5%.
margins_costs.quote: So, our primary estimate suggests that we can improve on operating margin by 1.5% with the help of manufacturing this chemical in-house.

capital_allocation.quote: Yes. So, from the loan given to Prabha Energy, we have received back almost INR86 crores from them.

capital_allocation.quote: So as of now, we are not foreseeing any equity raise.

risks_headwinds.quote: But due to an unfortunate incident at one of our wells at Mori 5, the incremental production was delayed by 5 to 6 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Blast at the GAIL site increased scrutiny on the processes followed by the producers and transporters of Gas and resulted in regulations being made more stringent.
risks_headwinds.quote: Blast at the GAIL site increased scrutiny on the processes followed by the producers and transporters of Gas and resulted in regulations being made more stringent

management_commitments.quote: We expect to start contributing through incremental production by October 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to clear and receive the entire loan repayment from Prabha Energy by the end of the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And probably by end of second quarter, we are expecting to clear the entire loan repaid.
